post.title: A fake Coinbase support rep took nearly $16 million
post.ig:
A fake Coinbase support rep took nearly $16 million.

He told about 100 Coinbase users a hacker was after their accounts, then had them move crypto to a wallet he controlled. In Sept 2026 he was sentenced to 4 to 12 years (Brooklyn DA).
Tech/customer support scam losses reported to the FBI hit $2.1 billion in 2025, up from $0.81 billion in 2022.
Coinbase says no one will ever ask for your password, 2FA codes, or for you to move assets to a new wallet.

Sources: Brooklyn DA (Sept 2026), FBI IC3 2024 and 2025 reports, Coinbase Help Center, FTC.
News and education, not financial advice.
